The '''Manaxia system''' was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Arrowhead" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the substance known as [[Manaxian amber]].<ref name="Insider135">{{InsiderCite|135|Roll of the Dice}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Manaxian amber]]|system=Manaxia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Manaxia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
